breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the full unsymmetric bending formula including the product of inertia Iyz = 800,000 mm^4 in both the numerator terms and the denominator (Iy·Iz − Iyz^2). It does not ignore Iyz or fall back to the simple superposition of My·z/Iy + Mz·y/Iz. This matches the ground truth prompt's intent to apply the proper unsymmetric bending formula with the nonzero product of inertia.
